def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(v!=0 for v in r)]
    # top non-zero bar row and bottom one
    top=[i for i in rows if i< len(g)//2][0] if rows else None
    # simpler: find first row with nonzero, last row with nonzero, and middle bar
    nz=[i for i in range(h) if any(g[i][j]!=0 for j in range(w))]
    bars=sorted(nz)
    top_bar=bars[0]; bot_bar=bars[-1]
    cols_top={j for j in range(w) if g[top_bar][j]!=0}
    cols_bot={j for j in range(w) if g[bot_bar][j]!=0}
    c=min(cols_top & cols_bot)
    for i in range(top_bar+1, bot_bar):
        g[i][c]=4
    return g
